contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IM]P CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG ; R/ PM TRP COS III

Silver coin. Denarius of Hadrian; cracked and bent; RIC volume 2 no. 85, mint of Rome issue of 119-122. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [IM]P CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG. Reverse description: Fortuna standing left holding cornucopiae and rudder. Reverse inscription: PM TRP COS III. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 2.81gms, die axis: 6
